name: CSTAR active catheter
full_name: CSTAR robot-assisted active-catheter insertion test bed (7-DOF PA10-7C arm inserting an SMA-actuated catheter)
group: Western University / Canadian Surgical Technologies and Advanced Robotics (CSTAR) (R. V. Patel; J. Jayender, M. Azizian) with NRC Integrated Manufacturing Technologies Institute (S. Nikumb, SMA micro-welding)
versions: 2006 ICRA hybrid impedance (force/position) control of catheter insertion by a 7-DOF redundant robot with proximal force sensing (title; rafiitari2014_current Sec. Robotic platforms); 2007 IROS autonomous insertion with image guidance (title); 2008 TRO autonomous image-guided insertion (full); 2008 BioRob wave-variable bilateral teleoperation of the active catheter (title); 2009 IJRR augmented hybrid impedance control + master-slave SMA tip control (full, jayender2009_robot)
target_anatomy: vascular/angioplasty access (vinyl-tube vessel test bed); PCI-size (5 Fr) catheters as motivation
devices_driven: one 5 Fr guide catheter (Medtronic) instrumented with SMA actuators: three SMA wires at 120 deg, several sections (TRO 2008 Sec. II, VII)
n_dof_detail: 7 (Mitsubishi PA10-7C arm) plus SMA tip bending (yaw and pitch)
translation_detail: other: 7-DOF industrial arm (Mitsubishi PA10-7C) inserts the catheter in strokes whose length is set from image feedback
rotation_detail: arm wrist (catheter roll use N.R.); tip steering by SMA actuators
force_sensing: ATI Gamma 6-DOF wrist force/torque sensor regulates insertion force (TRO 2008 Sec. II)
haptics_leader: none in TRO 2008 (clinician sets start and target in a GUI); IJRR 2009: Phantom Omni gives yaw/pitch references for the SMA tip (closed loop on an NDI Aurora tip sensor, 30 Hz) and the user sets the insertion stroke (Sec. 3.2, 5.4, Fig. 4); bilateral wave-variable teleoperation in BioRob 2008 (title only)
imaging_compat: camera images of the test bed as X-ray stand-in (about 1.0 mm/pixel) plus 5-DOF NDI Aurora EM sensor at the tip (TRO 2008 Sec. II-III)
validation_detail: autonomous insertion through a vinyl-tube test bed with tubes of 3.0, 4.5 and 6.0 mm internal diameter and two bifurcations (second at a random 3-D angle) (TRO 2008 Sec. II, VIII); IJRR 2009: position, force, and force+moment control runs in the 3.0 mm tube, then a teleoperated run through two active branches (left, then right) with SMA bending at each junction (Sec. 5, Figs. 7-20)
key_numbers: arm Cartesian tracking RMS 0.27/0.30/0.43 mm (x/y/z) and 0.18/0.06/0.17 deg; force tracking RMS 0.05 N; host-arm loop 333 Hz; EM sensor RMS 0.9-1.3 mm (TRO 2008 Sec. II, VI); insertion force regulated at 0.25 N, never exceeded through two active branches (IJRR 2009 Sec. 5.4, Fig. 20)
